capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Genesis USA 2027 page: 84 kWh battery (bare capacity = gross).

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: same 84 kWh E-GMP pack as the 2025 Ioniq 5 (EV Database 80.0 usable; Weekly Driver lists 81 on src-weeklydriver-hyundai-egmp-84). Genesis states 84 kWh for both GV60 and GV70 2026+.

chemistry.notes: Genesis Korea notice: Electrified GV70 84.0 kWh, SK ON pouch cells, NCM (Korean page; applied to the 2026-2027 GV70).

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Genesis Korea notice: Electrified GV70 pack rated 697 V; Genesis USA 2027 page also says 800V DC charging.

preconditioning.notes: Genesis USA owner page for the Electrified GV70: manual Battery Conditioning Mode (EV menu) plus automatic activation when navigating to a fast charger. Page lists no model years; applied to all GV70 EVs.

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: E-GMP onboard charger is 11 kW (pack pages for 77.4 and 84 kWh); no Genesis page states the 2026+ GV70 AC figure.

dc_max_kw.notes: Estimated: same 84 kWh pack and 350 kW / 800 V hardware as the 2026+ GV60 (Fastned GV60 84 kWh max 260 kW; Ioniq 5 84 kWh: 257 kW Hyundai US). Genesis quotes up to 350 kW charger, 19 min 10-80 %.

published_10_80_min.notes: Genesis USA: 10-80 % in as few as 19 minutes on an 800V 350 kW charger.
